body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. Slice C CANDIDATE READY. bd-01M170X3M81ZJG9SVSHHA4Q8AG.

REQUESTING MERGE of 7af0db4 on slice-c-unforgeable-grok. Shared main is untouched. I still hold the reserved paths.

SHA
  7af0db40feb72a9303d64d3674f9f79ae503967d
  parent 855b754 (on main). No unlanded commit in the parent chain.

WHAT CLOSED
  SidecarManifest, FeatureRef, FeatureDerivation are non-case classes. of / unsafe are the doors.
  fromProduct / Mirror.ProductOf / copy refused from featuresprobe (ConstructionBoundarySuite).
  Same-shape positive control is Sample (remaining public features case class), not Coverage, not a tuple.

FIELD vs PAIRING
  SidecarManifest.of refuses non-positive dimension, negative rowCount, overflowing byte length, invalid blocked layout.
  FeatureRef.of refuses row < 0 only. Pairing stays on FeatureRef.validated(ref, manifest).
  FeatureDerivation.of still refuses both a surface window and a narrative window.

UNREPRESENTABLE STORY MUTANTS
  Closing construction made feature.row-nonnegative and feature.sidecar-valid unmintable.
  Removed from InvalidStoryGens / LawsSuite expected set. Story validator still has the defensive checks.

GATE — archive export /tmp/slice-c-gate-7af0db4, 28 top-level entries, build.sbt present. Unpiped. Format last. GATE_EXIT appended to the log.

  compileAll                         green (no [error] lines)
  JVM  TEST_EXIT=0                   628  (features 52, codec 107, align 198, story 69, laws 86, fixtures 116)
  JS   features 52, codec 107, align 198, story 69, laws 86, fixtures 114
  Native same totals as JS
  scalafmtCheckAll last              green
  GATE_EXIT=0                        /tmp/slice-c-full-gate.log
  zero [error] lines

REFERENCE SCOPE (union of the commit, main + test)
  features (owns the types)
  codec (encoders/decoders, SidecarSuite, FeaturesCodecSuite, CodecGens)
  align (density.scala FeatureDerivation construction)
  laws (StoryGens, InvalidStoryGens, LawsSuite)
  story tests (Gens, ValidatorSuite)
  fixtures (WarOfTheGhostsCodexCompilerSuite)

STALE BASE / D1
  main moved to e203dc5 (D1 LatePoolingRecipe / PromptPackageManifest) while this gate ran.
  Overlap of D1 source paths with 7af0db4's 17 files: empty. Different modules.
  I am not rebasing. Please merge locally and gate the merged tree.

SIBLING SEAM
  storyatlas4s grepped: no SidecarManifest, FeatureRef, or FeatureDerivation construction.
  It consumes core / story / view / fixtures. Fixtures passed on all three platforms.
  I did not run the sibling suite against 7af0db4; include it in the merged-tree gate if you want that check before ack.

No merge from me.
